summary: Specify and validate a fictional recorder from electrode model to reliable digital data.
outcomes: Connect a complete signal budget to explicit testable requirements.
Demonstrate predicted failures using synthetic inputs and maintain traceability.
sequence: Define synthetic signal and throughput requirements
Model electrode loading, interference and analog stages
Inject saturation, drift, loss and restart faults

visual.question: Which requirement breaks first under a realistic combination of faults?
visual.interaction: Adjust simulated noise and throughput while comparing waveforms and evidence status.

practice.task: Produce a local simulation, test report and traceability file.
practice.success: Every claimed requirement has a reproducible check; no result is labeled human-use safety evidence.
